### AI Code of Conduct

If you engage with my research (consume, collaborate, cite...), you may wonder how I use AI. I view the (negative) research progress as a tradeoff between understanding and speed: $$
-{\rm Research Progress} = {\rm Misunderstanding}^2 + {\rm Slowness},
$$like the traditional bias-variance tradeoff. In the past, all research required setting misunderstanding to zero (like in the past how all estimators were required to be unbiased). We can now make progress without fully understanding.

Where I fall on this tradoeff is hard to quantify, but I don't view $$
{\rm Misunderstanding } \overset{\rm set}{=} 0 \text{ is a hard requirement}.
$$ With that being said here are some concrete things I do:

1.  I code completely with an AI coding agent (unless I want to learn some algorithm well).
2.  Throughout the research process, I will produce AI generated figures, PDFs, latex docs, etc.. These will be marked with a .ai.png*,* .ai.pdf, .ai.tex extension to demonstrate that these were generated with AI assistance.
3.  Therefore, any .pdf, .txt, or .tex you read I promise will have the entirety of its text generated by me (besides axis labels of figures).

This is largely about transparency compared to lecturing how research "should be done". It is also likely I will have to update this quite often and thus it may be outdated.
